verdict.rationale: Sentry's alert rules explicitly support calling webhooks in addition to notifications/tickets/integrations (sentry-docs-21), enabling automated remediation flows, and Sentry also ships an official MCP server and AI-agent tooling (sentry-docs-2, sentry-probe-3) that could consume such triggers. Missing for 10: no documented example of webhook payload wired specifically to an agent/remediation pipeline, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of this exact workflow.
